note: Glue submodule: one event subscriber (SimpleSitemapSyncExtend, service cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap.event_subscriber) that carries per-entity Simple Sitemap settings across sites via Content Sync push/pull events. No config/UI/Drush/permissions. Medium introspects the running container for that subscriber; hard is an enable-the-integration task (safe to toggle - no dependents). No sync backend needed.

evals.prompt: What does the cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap module do, and which contrib module does it require besides cms_content_sync?
evals.expected_output: It carries an entity's Simple Sitemap settings (inclusion, priority, changefreq) with it during Content Sync push/pull, preserving per-entity sitemap configuration across sites. It requires the contrib simple_sitemap module plus cms_content_sync.

evals.prompt: How does cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap integrate with Content Sync? Name the Content Sync events its subscriber listens to.
evals.expected_output: Through one event subscriber (SimpleSitemapSyncExtend) subscribing to BeforeEntityTypeExport, BeforeEntityPush and AfterEntityPull.

evals.prompt: The cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap module adds a property to the Content Sync payload. What is that property named, and which major versions of Simple Sitemap does the integration support?
evals.expected_output: The property is named 'simple_sitemap' (SimpleSitemapSyncExtend::PROPERTY_NAME). The integration supports Simple Sitemap v3 and v4 APIs.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, the cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap integration is active. Inspect the service container and give the machine id of the event subscriber service this module registers.
evals.expected_output: The service id is cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap.event_subscriber (class SimpleSitemapSyncExtend). Confirm with drush ev '\Drupal::getContainer()->has("cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap.event_subscriber")'.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site uses Content Sync and the contrib simple_sitemap module. Enable the Content Sync integration that keeps per-entity Simple Sitemap settings in sync across sites during push/pull.
evals.expected_output: The cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap module is enabled (e.g. drush en cms_content_sync_simple_sitemap -y), registering the SimpleSitemapSyncExtend event subscriber.
